name: Canada, City & Falls
pere: Explore Toronto's waterfront, historic neighborhoods, and the dramatic natural scenery of Niagara Falls.
description: Discover Canada's biggest city before taking in the gardens, viewpoints, and thundering water of Niagara Falls. This balanced week combines urban culture with an easy nature escape.
highlights: Walk Toronto's waterfront and Distillery District
Enjoy city views from the CN Tower area
Take a guided day trip to Niagara Falls
Explore local markets and Canadian food
included: Round-trip transport for the Niagara Falls day trip

name: France, Eiffel Tower
pere: See Paris's iconic Eiffel Tower, riverside boulevards, celebrated museums, and neighborhood cafes.
description: Spend a week discovering Paris at an unhurried pace, from the Eiffel Tower and Seine to the galleries and cafe-lined streets that give each neighborhood its character.
bestSeason: April to June or September to October
highlights: See the Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars
Cruise or stroll along the Seine
Explore the Louvre district and historic center
Enjoy time for independent cafe and neighborhood visits

name: South Africa Safari
pere: Experience South Africa's wildlife and landscapes with a guided safari and time to discover the region.
description: Combine a wildlife-focused safari with time to appreciate South Africa's varied landscapes. A local guide helps make each game drive informative and respectful of the animals.
bestSeason: May to September for safari viewing
highlights: Join guided wildlife game drives
Learn about local conservation
Take in open savanna and bush landscapes
Enjoy regional dishes and cultural experiences

name: Amazon Rainforest
pere: Travel into the Amazon with local naturalist guides for rainforest walks, river journeys, and wildlife spotting.
description: Base yourself at a responsibly operated rainforest lodge and explore the Amazon by river and on guided forest walks. Daily plans adapt to weather and wildlife conditions.
bestSeason: June to November for lower water; December to May for high water
highlights: Travel by boat on Amazon waterways
Join guided rainforest walks
Look for birds and other wildlife with a naturalist
Learn about local ecosystems and communities

name: United Arab Emirates, Desert
pere: Pair Dubai's striking architecture and lively waterfront with a guided desert experience.
description: Explore Dubai's modern landmarks and traditional districts, then head into the desert with a licensed guide for a sunset landscape experience.
highlights: See Dubai's skyline and waterfront
Explore the historic Al Fahidi district
Take a guided desert safari
Enjoy a free day for beaches or museums
included: Shared desert safari with hotel pickup

name: Rome, Colosseum
pere: Explore Rome's ancient landmarks, piazzas, and food traditions on a culture-rich city break.
description: Follow Rome's story from the Colosseum and Roman Forum to lively piazzas and neighborhood trattorias. The itinerary leaves open time for museums and independent discoveries.
bestSeason: April to June or September to October
highlights: Visit the Colosseum and Roman Forum area
Walk through the historic center and its piazzas
Discover Trastevere's food and evening atmosphere
Enjoy a guided introduction to Rome's history
excluded: Colosseum and museum admission unless specified

name: New York City, Tour
pere: Take in New York's skyline, landmark neighborhoods, museums, and the energy of the city streets.
description: Get to know New York through its distinct neighborhoods, waterfront views, and landmark avenues. The plan mixes a guided first look with flexible time to explore.
bestSeason: April to June or September to November
highlights: Walk through Central Park and Midtown
See the city from a waterfront viewpoint
Explore a neighborhood food and culture walk
Choose from museums, theaters, and local markets

name: Paris, City of Light
pere: Discover Paris's grand boulevards, art-filled neighborhoods, Eiffel Tower views, and classic French cuisine.
description: A Paris week with a little of everything: famous sights, time in historic neighborhoods, and space to enjoy the city's food and art at your own pace.
bestSeason: April to June or September to October
highlights: See the Eiffel Tower and Seine riverbanks
Explore Montmartre and the historic center
Visit an art museum of your choice
Sample French pastries and neighborhood cuisine

name: Udaipur Heritage Escape
pere: Discover Udaipur's lakeside palaces, old-city lanes, artisan markets, and Mewar heritage.
description: Enjoy Udaipur's lakeside setting and royal history, from City Palace and old-city lanes to a relaxed boat ride and local craft markets.
highlights: Explore the City Palace complex
Take a boat ride on Lake Pichola
Walk through the old city and artisan bazaars
Taste Rajasthani specialties
